caption:
A first-person view from a rider on a trident-and-arrow patterned mat with a yellow handle carries through an enclosed transparent water-slide tube beside a teal aquarium. The rider's legs in black shorts and one dark water shoe rest at the bottom, kicking up white splashes. Ahead a forward tunnel holds a distant rider. Through the clear right wall the aquarium shows swimming yellow-tailed fish, a bright green rectangular frame, and dark framework.

Over the clip the view pans rightward. The forward tunnel and distant rider slide from center toward the left edge and leave the frame. The transparent wall showing the aquarium fills progressively more of the image. The rider's legs drift toward the lower left and partly out of sight as the splashing around the feet becomes less visible. The yellow-tailed fish move independently, and the bright green frame translates leftward.

A blurred brownish vertical shape becomes more prominent toward the center-right. A curved cream-colored tube seam enters from the left, while droplets streak the wet transparent surface throughout.
